questions.text: What does the LORD declare at the beginning in Zephaniah 1:3?

options.text: I will choose a people and gather the nations unto my holy mountain
I will consume man and beast, fowls and fishes, and cut off all man
I will destroy the heathen that afflict my heritage and root them out
I will renew the whole earth, that all people and cattle dwell safely

questions.text: Which idolatries are condemned in Zephaniah 1:4-5?

options.text: The images of the serpent, worshippers of the moon, and swearers by idols
The groves of Ashtaroth, priests upon the high places, and swearers by Moloch
The remnant of Baal, worshippers of heaven on housetops, and swearers by Malcham
The altars of Beth-el, worshippers of the sun on walls, and swearers by Chemosh

questions.text: Against whom is the search of Jerusalem with candles directed in Zephaniah 1:12?

options.text: Against the merchants at the gate that deal deceitfully and oppress the needy
Against the thieves in the night that break into houses and spoil the wealthy
Against the false priests that prophesy peace and sacrifice unto strange gods
Against them that are settled on their lees, that say: The LORD will not do good, neither will he do evil

questions.text: What counsel is given in Zephaniah 2:3?

options.text: Seek ye the LORD, righteousness and meekness, that ye may be hid in the day of anger
Flee unto the high mountains and hide in the caves, that ye may be spared from wrath
Offer sacrifices upon the altar of the temple, that ye may find mercy in judgment
Take shield and sword to fight against the nations, that ye may overcome the battle

questions.text: What shall become of Moab and Ammon according to Zephaniah 2:9?

options.text: Moab and Ammon shall be subdued unto Judah and pay tribute
Moab shall be as Sodom and Ammon as Gomorrah, a perpetual desolation
Moab and Ammon shall be delivered and dwell safely in their land
Moab and Ammon shall become mighty empires ruling over the heathen

questions.text: What is prophesied concerning Nineveh in Zephaniah 2:13-14?

options.text: It shall be overthrown by an earthquake and sunken deep into the sea
It shall be besieged by kings of the east and utterly consumed with fire
It shall be a desolation and dry like a wilderness, where beasts lie down
It shall become a city of refuge for all nations, bringing lasting peace

questions.text: How does Zephaniah 3:3 judge the rulers of Jerusalem?

options.text: Her priests are faithful and teach the people the law in truth
Her princes are wise shepherds that care for the flock
Her judges are just and judge without respect of persons
Her princes are roaring lions; her judges are evening wolves

questions.text: What people will the LORD leave in Jerusalem according to Zephaniah 3:12?

options.text: An afflicted and poor people, and they shall trust in the LORD
A mighty and wealthy people that shall rebuild the temple gates
A learned council of scribes that shall teach the holy covenant
A valiant army of warriors that shall subdue all foreign nations

questions.text: What promise is given in Zephaniah 3:17?

options.text: The LORD sendeth thee a Saviour and will be with thee from afar off
The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee
The LORD will judge thee once more and rejoice over thy destruction
The LORD forgetteth thee not, but calleth thee back into his house

questions.text: In whose reign did Zephaniah prophesy (Zephaniah 1:1)?

options.text: In the days of Josiah the son of Amon
In the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah
In the days of Manasseh the son of Hezekiah
In the days of Hezekiah the son of Ahaz

questions.text: What has the LORD prepared according to Zephaniah 1:7?

options.text: A burnt offering which he alone will consume upon the altar
A feast of reconciliation unto which he calleth all nations
A sacrifice, and he hath bid his guests
A feast unto which he hath bidden the poor of the land

questions.text: From which gate shall the noise of a cry arise according to Zephaniah 1:10?

options.text: From the water gate
From the horse gate
From the sheep gate
From the fish gate

questions.text: Which two descriptions are given for the day of the LORD in Zephaniah 1:15?

options.text: A day of joy and of thanksgiving
A day of clouds and thick darkness
A day of darkness and gloominess
A day of quietness and restful peace

questions.text: What shall not be able to deliver them in the day of the LORD's wrath (Zephaniah 1:18)?

options.text: Neither their silver nor their gold
Neither their walls nor high towers
Neither their sacrifices nor vows
Neither their horses nor chariots

questions.text: Which nation of the seacoast is threatened in Zephaniah 2:5?

options.text: The Amalekites, the land of the desert
The Cherethites, the land of Philistines
The Phoenicians, the land of old Tyre
The Midianites, the land by the Red sea

questions.text: What does the LORD do every morning according to Zephaniah 3:5?

options.text: He accepteth the offerings of the righteous and blesseth all the land
He searcheth the secret thoughts of men and punisheth evil in silence
He bringeth his judgment to light every morning, and he faileth not
He sendeth forth his prophets to call all the nations unto repentance

questions.text: What will the LORD turn to the people according to Zephaniah 3:9?

options.text: A new heart, that they may faithfully keep the commandments
A peaceful land, that they may dwell securely and in quietness
A righteous law, that they may understand the worship of Zion
A pure language, that they may all call upon the name of the LORD

questions.text: What has the LORD taken away from the daughter of Zion in Zephaniah 3:15?

options.text: Her judgments, and he hath cast out her enemy
Her law, and he hath given her a new covenant
Her king, and he hath set over her a judge
Her walls, and he hath opened her gates
